title: Story draft — frontmatter schema
description: The YAML frontmatter of a draft in .stories/<slug>/. One of four shapes, chosen by `type`. additionalProperties is false everywhere: no key outside this schema. Optional keys are omitted, never left empty. Rules JSON Schema cannot express: a relation is declared only on the side that is blocked or that is the child; an item has at most one PARENT; a PARENT is always an EPIC; the entries of relations are ordered by relationType (PARENT, BLOCKED_BY, RELATED), then type (EPIC, US, SPIKE, TASK), then id. validate-story.sh checks the first three.

id.description: Provisional and progressive per type (US-01, EPIC-01, TASK-01, SPIKE-01), or the ClickUp custom id of an item that already exists.

title.description: Short and descriptive, with no id in front. The Epic prefix of a subtask is added at publication.

products.description: The product tags from product.md's product index. Required when the index exists; an Epic spanning products lists them all.

relations.description: Referenced id -> relation. The id is quoted in YAML.

epic.description: An Epic has no parent: the workspace nests one level.

spike.description: The item a spike unblocks declares it with BLOCKED_BY.
